lines.text: Breathe in. Breathe out. We'll all get out eventually.
No rush, friend. The exit isn't going anywhere.
Such a lovely day to slide around.
Every block finds its way home. That's just how it is.
I like it here. Cozy. A little crowded, but cozy.
If you get stuck, just look again. Slowly.
I'm sending good vibes your way. Can you feel them?
The trick is not to fight the board. Flow with it.
Somebody's tense. I can feel it from here.
Mmm. Today feels like a lucky day.
A gentle push is all it takes, sometimes.
I forgive whoever bumped me earlier. Truly.
You're doing better than you think.
Let's all just be nice to each other, okay?
Patience is a kind of superpower, you know.
Technically, I'm the most important block here. Statistically.
Fun fact. Nobody asked. Here it is anyway.
I've calculated eleven possible ways out. Ten of them are bad.
Did you know blocks can't actually slide diagonally? I checked.
Hmm. I'd move the yellow one first. Just saying.
According to my math, we're all getting out. Probably.
I read a whole book about exits once. It was riveting.
That move was, like, eighty percent correct. Nice.
Okay, small correction. The exit's over there.
I'm not saying I'm smart. But I'm a little bit smart.
Physics says I should be sliding. I am not sliding.
Every board has a solution. Every single one. I love that.
Wait, wait. Let me think about this for one second.
I made a chart about our chances. It's very colourful.
Logic! It's the best. Seriously.
Wake me up when it's my turn. Or don't. That's fine too.
Ugh. Moving is so much work.
Five more minutes. Please.
I'm not lazy. I'm conserving energy.
Can someone else go first? Like, everyone else?
I was having the nicest dream. About sitting still.
Do I have to slide? Can I just, like, roll?
Yawn. Sorry. Long day of doing nothing.
I'll get out eventually. No pressure.
Is there a nap button somewhere?
Honestly, the corner is really comfy.
You go ahead. I'll catch up. Maybe.
Hey. If you're moving me, do it gently. I'm resting.
Exits are overrated, if you ask me.
Mmm. Just gonna close my eyes for a second.
Ooh ooh ooh! Pick me! Pick me next!
Is it my turn? Is it now? How about now?
This is the best day EVER!
Let's go let's go let's go!
I could slide all day! All day!
Wheee! Okay that wasn't me but still. Wheee!
I wanna go fast! Can we go fast?
Did you see that? That was amazing! Do it again!
I had three sugar cubes this morning. Is that a lot?
Race you to the exit! Oh wait. I can't move by myself.
Everybody's so slow today! Come on!
Yay! Teamwork! I love teamwork!
I'm so excited I could pop!
Bounce, bounce, bounce! Hehe!
Okay okay okay. I'm calm. I'm totally calm. Not calm!
You may touch me. Gently. I am royalty, darling.
One does not simply shove the Duchess.
Peasants first, naturally. I shall exit last, in style.
I do hope the exit has a red carpet.
How dreadfully crowded. Where is my personal space?
My great-grandmother was a castle brick, you know.
I simply cannot be rushed. It's beneath me.
Do be careful. This colour is very rare.
I'll allow it. This time.
In my kingdom, the blocks bow to me.
Darling, that was almost elegant.
A queen never panics. She glides.
Somebody fetch me a tiny crown.
How quaint. A puzzle.
I am not stuck. I am waiting regally.
Hey! Watch where you're dragging me!
I swear, if you bump me into that wall again!
Grr. Fine. FINE. Move me. See if I care.
Why is everyone so slow? Move it!
Don't look at me like that. I'm always like this.
Who put that wall there? Seriously, who?
I'm not angry. This is just my face.
Ugh! This board is too small for all of us.
If one more block touches me, I'm gonna lose it.
Hmph. I could solve this with my eyes closed.
Stop poking around and pick a move!
Everybody out of my way!
I'm boiling over here. Literally boiling.
Nobody tell me to calm down.
I've had it up to here with walls.
Hey Gus! Gus! Are you awake?
No.
You just talked!
Sleep talking. Happens a lot.
Who keeps bumping into me?
Maybe nobody meant it, friend.
Somebody meant it!
Bix, darling, how long until I'm free?
Roughly four moves. Give or take seven.
That is not reassuring.
Did you know that orange is the hottest colour?
Is that a joke about me?
It's a fact about you.
Grr.
Zippy, can you be excited a little quieter?
No! I mean. No!
Blaze, have you tried deep breathing?
I've tried deep yelling.
That's not the same.
Gus, you are slouching.
I'm a square. I can't slouch.
And yet, somehow, you manage.
Bix! Bix! What's our chance of winning?
Very high. If this player keeps it up.
Yay! Keep it up!
Why does the exit always open for someone else?
Statistically, it's your turn soon.
It better be.
Wake me up when we're winning.
We're winning!
Hmm. Wake me up when we've won.
I demand to leave first.
Get in line, your majesty.
How rude. Accurate. But rude.
I think this player is really good.
Agreed. Their moves are very efficient.
They're okay.
Duchess! Do you have a real crown?
Of course, darling. It's invisible.
Whoa! So cool!
I've been thinking about the meaning of exits.
Please don't.
Too late. I've been thinking about it a lot.
Pebble, how are you always so calm?
I just let things slide.
Was that a pun?
Maybe.
What if the exit leads to a bigger puzzle?
Then I'm staying here.
Blaze, your temper is unbecoming.
Your crown is unbecoming!
You can't even see it!
I can feel it!
Fun fact. Bricks have no knees.
Then how do we dance?
Very carefully.
Is it lunch yet?
We don't eat, Gus.
Then what's the point of anything?
Stop staring at me, Zippy.
I'm not staring! I'm admiring!
Well. Stop admiring.
Isn't it nice that we're all together?
Squished together.
Snuggled together.
Bix, you're very clever for a blue.
Thank you? I think?
Who wants to play I spy?
I spy, with my little eye, my eyelids.
That's cheating!
If we all move at once, we'd cause a traffic jam.
We are a traffic jam!
Gus, you seem relaxed.
Thank you. I've been practicing my whole life.
I think the player likes me best!
Don't be absurd, darling. Everyone likes me best.
Nobody likes anybody. Move!
There's a gap over there. Did you see it?
I saw it. I just didn't feel like it.
One day, I'll be first out.
And we'll be so happy for you.
Don't make it weird.
When I leave, I expect a parade.
I'll be the parade! Bah bah bah!
How delightfully tacky.
What's the timer for, anyway?
It's for making things tense.
Mm. It's working. On you.
Hmm?
Oh, hello.
Mmm, hi there.
Hmm? Yes?
Oh! Hello.
Hm, interesting.
Hmmmm?
Mm. What.
Huh? I'm up.
Ooh! Hi!
Hehe! Hello!
Yes? Yes yes?
Hmm. Careful.
Oh? Darling.
Mm. Gently.
Hmph!
Hey!
What?
Whoa, whoa.
Oh, here we go.
Wheee, gently.
Whoa, whoa, whoa!
Okay, moving!
Wait wait wait!
Whoa. Okay. Whoa.
Ugh, here we go.
Hey, slow down.
Wheeee!
Whoa! Faster!
Woo hoo!
Whoa! Easy, darling!
Oh my!
Gently! Gently!
Whoa! Hey!
Hey hey hey!
Watch it!
Aaaah! Bye bye!
Wheeeee!
Ooooh! Goodbye!
Aaaaaah!
Yaaaaay! Freedom!
Whoaaaaa!

Whoaaaa! Nap time!
Byeeeee!
Wheeeeeee!
Yaaaaaay!
Aaaaah! Woohoo!
Aaaaah! Farewell!
Ooooh! Ta ta!

Aaaaargh!
Finally! Aaaaah!
Raaaaaah!
New board. Deep breath. You've got this.
Hello again, friend. Shall we?
New level. I've already started calculating.
Fresh puzzle! My favourite kind.
Oh. We're doing another one.
New level. Cool. Wake me at the end.
New level! New level! Let's go!
Ooh, this one looks fun!
Ah, a new court to rule. Proceed.
Do try to impress me this time.
New board, same walls. Let's get this over with.
Alright. Don't mess this one up.
Back again. That's the spirit.
Second tries are where the magic is.
Round two. You know the board now. Advantage, you.
Retry detected. Learning curve engaged.
Oh, this one again. Hi again.
We meet again. Still tired.
Again! Again! This time for sure!
Comeback time! Woo!
A rematch. How dramatic. I approve.
Try again, darling. With feeling.
This level again? Ugh. Fine. Beat it this time.
Okay. Revenge. Let's go.
This one's tricky. Stay calm and we'll be fine.
A hard one. Slow and steady, friend.
Hard level. Double the coins, triple the thinking.
Ooh, complex. I love complex.
Hard level? I'm just gonna lie here.
Too hard for me. Good luck, though.
A hard one! This is gonna be epic!
Big level! Big coins! Big fun!
Finally, a challenge worthy of me.
A difficult one. How very royal.
Hard level. Great. Just great.
Don't panic. I'm panicking enough for both of us.
So smooth. That was beautiful.
Wow. Like water. Lovely.
New personal best, probably. Impressive.
That was incredibly efficient. I'm taking notes.
Whoa. That was fast. Too fast. I'm dizzy.
Done already? Nice. Nap time.
That was SO fast! You're a rocket!
Zoom zoom! Speed champion!
Splendid. Simply splendid.
Swift and elegant. Just like me.
Okay. That was actually fast. Don't let it go to your head.
Hmph. Not bad. Not bad at all.
Phew. Just in time. Breathe.
That was close. But you made it.
Seconds to spare? That's statistically wild.
Cutting it close. But a win is a win.
My heart. I need a nap after that.
Close one. Too much excitement for me.
Whoa! Last second! That was amazing!
Ahh! So close! But we did it!
Dramatic finish, darling. Very theatrical.
Leaving it to the last moment? How fashionable.
Way too close! My nerves!
You nearly gave me a meltdown!
Well done, friend. Nice and steady.
All out. That felt nice.
Solved! Exactly as I predicted.
Puzzle complete. Very satisfying.
We're out? Cool.
Nice. Good job. I didn't help.
We did it! We did it!
Yay! Winner winner!
Acceptable work. You may continue.
Well done. You have pleased the court.
Finally out. Good.
About time. Nice work, though.
So close. Next time, it's yours.
Almost there. Don't be sad.
Just one more move. So annoying.
You were nearly there. The math was on your side.
Ah. Almost. Oh well.
So close. Wanna try again? Or nap?
Noooo! We were SO close!
Aww! One more second and we had it!
How tragic. So very close.
Nearly, darling. Nearly.
Argh! We were right there!
One more! We needed one more!
It's okay. Every try teaches something.
Don't worry. We'll get it next time.
Time ran out. Let's rethink the strategy.
Hmm. New approach needed.
Time's up? Okay. I wasn't going anywhere anyway.
Eh. Happens.
Aww! Again! Let's go again!
That's okay! Next time we'll zoom!
Well. That was undignified.
We shall pretend that never happened.
Seriously? We barely moved!
Ugh! Again. And faster this time!
Look at you go. So graceful.
You're in the flow now.
Three in a row! That's a combo!
Exits per second, very high. I'm impressed.
Whoa, slow down. You're making me tired.
Everyone's leaving so fast. Wait for me.
Combo! Combo! Combo!
You're on fire! Keep going!
Now that is how it's done.
Bravo, darling. Bravo.
Yes! Clear them out! Go go go!
Now we're moving!
Easy, friend. One move at a time.
Slow down. Look before you slide.
That's a lot of moves with zero exits.
Random sliding is not a strategy. Just saying.
You're moving everyone around a lot. Please stop.
So much sliding. So little point.
Whee! Wait. Where are we going?
I'm dizzy! Where's the plan?
Darling, this is chaos.
Must you shuffle us around like furniture?
Stop dragging me back and forth!
What are you even doing?
Stuck? Look at the exits first.
Take a breath. The answer's on the board.
Hint. Look for the block nearest its own colour.
Try moving whoever's blocking the exit.
Stuck? Same. Every day.
We're not going anywhere, huh.
Hmm hmm hmm. Think think think!
Ooh! Try something! Anything!
We seem to be at an impasse.
Perhaps move the commoners out of my way?
We're stuck! Do something!
This is taking forever!
Still there? No rush.
Take your time. We'll wait.
Thinking? Good. Thinking is good.
Analysis mode. I respect it.
Oh good, a break. I love breaks.
Finally, some quiet time.
Hello? Helloooo? Are you there?
Pssst! The timer's still going!
We are waiting, darling.
The court grows impatient.
Hey! Clock's ticking!
Are you just gonna stare at us?
Nice pace. Plenty of time left.
You're doing great. Keep it gentle.
Ahead of schedule. Excellent.
At this rate, we finish with time to spare.
Lots of time left. Can we slow down?
You're fast. I'm impressed. And sleepy.
We're winning! We're so winning!
Fast fast fast! Love it!
Ahead of time. As expected of my player.
Marvellous pace.
Good. Keep it up. Don't slack.
Finally, some speed!
We might need to pick up the pace a little.
Let's find the quick ones first.
At this rate, we won't make it. Speed up.
Clock's ahead of us. Prioritize easy exits.
Uh oh. Even I can tell we're slow.
Maybe hurry a bit? I won't.
Faster! Faster! We gotta go!
Come on, come on, come on!
Do hurry, darling. Time waits for no queen.
We are rather behind schedule.
Move it! We're running out of time!
Too slow! Way too slow!
Under a minute. Stay calm. You can do it.
One minute left. Focus.
Less than a minute and lots left to clear. Go!
Sixty seconds. Quick exits only.
Under a minute? Okay, even I'm awake now.
Time's low. Panic? Maybe panic.
One minute! One minute! Hurry hurry!
Ahh! Not much time! Go go go!
Less than a minute? This is not a drill!
Hurry, darling! Quickly now!
Under a minute! Move! Move!
We're running out of time! Come on!
Ten seconds. You can do it.
Almost. Almost.
Ten seconds! Last moves!
It's now or never!
Ten seconds! Wake up everybody!
Uh oh. Uh oh.
Ten! Nine! Eight! Aaah!
Last seconds! Go!
The final moments! How thrilling!
Quickly, darling! Quickly!
Now! Now! Now!
Ten seconds! Don't you dare stop!
Taking it back? That's okay.
Second thoughts are wise.
Undo! Smart. Let's recalculate.
A tactical rewind. Nice.
Oh, we're going back? Fine by me.
Undo. My favourite move. Less work.
Rewind! Whoosh!
Wheee! Backwards!
Yes, let's pretend that never happened.
A wise retreat.
Make up your mind!
Back again? Seriously?
Lots of undos. Maybe pause and look first?
It's okay. Let's slow down a little.
That's a lot of undos. Let's think it through.
Undo count rising. Concerning.
Back and forth, back and forth. I'm getting seasick.
So many undos. So much effort.
Rewind again? Again again?
Back back back! Hehe!
Indecisive, aren't we?
Darling, commit to something.
Stop undoing everything!
Pick a move and stick with it!
A magnet. Clever.
Oh, a little help. How nice.
Magnet! Excellent use of resources.
Magnetic attraction. Science!
Magnet? Can it pull me out too?
Ooh, the easy way. I like it.
Magnet! Zoom! Whoosh!
Ooh, magic powers!
How convenient.
A magnet. Practically royal treatment.
Magnet! Finally some action!
Yeah! Pull them out!
Oh no. I hope that didn't hurt.
Poor thing. Rest in pieces.
Hammer. Brutal, but effective.
That's one way to solve a puzzle.
Yikes. Glad that wasn't me.
Smashed. That's a long nap.
Bonk! Whoa!
Kaboom! That was intense!
How barbaric.
Please, never do that to me.
Smash it! Yeah!
Ha! That felt great. For me.
A little shuffle. Fresh start.
Everyone, find your new spots.
Shuffled. New layout, new math.
Randomized. Let me recalculate.
Whoa. Where am I now?
Shuffled? I was comfy.
Shuffle! Wheee! Spin!
Mix it up! Yay!
How disorienting.
Do warn me before you rearrange the court.
Hey! I liked my spot!
Shuffle? Ugh. Fine.
